observations: EDIT: implemented the opt-in beta magnitude clamp as specified. New config field beta_clamp_abs (default 0.0 = NO clamp, so existing/default configs are byte-for-byte unchanged); when >0 the fitted beta log-weights are clamped to [-x,+x] immediately after refit_beta_nnls and before they are written to the cache or fed to the value-solve as an attention bias, with a post-clamp assertion (max|beta| <= x) and a per-document log. IMPORT-RESOLUTION DISCOVERY (critical for the orchestrator): the FIRST launch crashed instantly with pydantic 'beta_clamp_abs Extra inputs are not permitted'. Root cause: the venv's editable install (__editable___cartridges_0_0_1_finder.py) maps `cartridges` to the SIBLING repo /localhome/local-triv/gated-continual-cartridges/cartridges and appends its finder to sys.meta_path, so a `python /abs/script.py` invocation (script-dir on sys.path, NOT cwd) imports the SIBLING package, which lacks this branch's edits. Confirmed the EXP-005b run.log traceback shows sibling paths (/localhome/local-triv/gated-continual-cartridges/cartridges/am/...), i.e. ALL prior beta runs (EXP-005/005b) executed the SIBLING cartridges, not _explore. Fix (in-scope): prepend PYTHONPATH=$CARTRIDGES_DIR so `import cartridges` resolves to _explore/cartridges (verified: resolves to _explore + beta_clamp_abs present); added to launch_exp006.sh. DID beta+clamp COMPLETE without NaN: NO. With the import fixed the run executed the _explore code (traceback paths confirm _explore) and processed documents 0,1,2 successfully (cache-after-doc-000/001/002.pt + cache-step1/2/3.pt saved -> the clamp bounded finite beta for those docs), then CRASHED on document index 3 (the SAME boundary as EXP-005b) with AssertionError 'beta clamp failed: max|beta|=nan > 3.0' at cartridges/am/finetune.py:557. Mechanism: on doc-3 refit_beta_nnls returned NaN log-weights for at least one (layer,head); torch.clamp(-3,3) leaves NaN unchanged, so the magnitude clamp cannot repair a NaN-valued fit and the post-clamp assertion (added by this edit) correctly detected it and halted. This is a DIFFERENT failure mode than the orchestrator hypothesis / EXP-005/005b: under the SIBLING package the doc-3 fit produced a huge-but-FINITE beta (max|beta|~66-68) and NaN only appeared later inside the value-solve (core.py:230, 'NaNs in ridge lstsq solution'); under the _explore package the NNLS fit itself returns NaN at doc-3 pre-solve. So the two am/beta code trees behave differently at doc-3, and the clamp-magnitude remedy (which bounds finite blow-ups) does not address a fit that is already NaN. QA/MT vs EXP-004/EXP-001: NO eval ran (crash preceded the aggregate/eval stage, no phase2_summary.json), so qa_forgetting_loss and mt_acquisition_loss are null (not fabricated) and HYP-T2 (does beta help MT-acquisition / hurt QA) remains UNANSWERED. Cost: phase2_e2e_s=370s wall (cold load + flex compile + 3 docs + crash) on flock-claimed GPU1; gpu_s unavailable; gradient_steps=0. CAVEATS: (1) the '[beta-clamp]' logger.info lines were swallowed because cartridges.am.finetune uses a bare getLogger with no handler configured (cartridges.cache uses the configured get_logger and IS visible), so the per-doc bounded max|beta| for docs 0-2 was not captured in the log although the clamp+assert executed; (2) the default-off behavior is preserved (beta_clamp_abs=0.0 unchanged), so no existing config is affected; (3) the run required the PYTHONPATH import fix to exercise the _explore edit at all -- prior baselines (EXP-004 beta-off numbers) were produced by the sibling package, so a strict apples-to-apples A/B would also re-run the beta-off baseline under _explore. No recommendations.
